headline: “Mexican economy continues expanding despite growing below potential”
summary: A committee spokesperson said Mexico's economy is growing below its potential but has not contracted. He said there is no evidence that the expansion phase that began in June 2020 has ended.
why: Mexico is Latin America's second-largest economy, and growth relative to potential shapes monetary policy and investor views of the country.
original_headline: “Economía mexicana sigue en expansión pese a crecer por debajo del potencial”
